name: Humberstone and Santa Laura Saltpeter Works
description: In the Atacama's Pampa del Tamarugal, one of the driest deserts on Earth, Humberstone and Santa Laura are abandoned saltpeter refineries in northern Chile. For over 60 years from 1880, thousands of workers from Chile, Peru and Bolivia lived here in company towns, producing nitrate fertilizer that fed farms across the Americas and Europe. Rusting machinery and empty buildings still stand in the desert.
